mukey.description: Stable USDA SSURGO map-unit join key; load as a string.

awc_weighted_cm_per_cm.description: Component-weighted surface-horizon available water capacity; not root-zone storage or current moisture.

slope_weighted_pct.description: Component-weighted representative slope (percent rise; may exceed 100).

total_component_pct_accounted.description: Source component coverage percentage; retained as a quality/context field.

root_zone_aws_0_150cm_mm.description: NRCS muaggatt.aws0_150wta, 0–150 cm root-zone available water storage; unavailable for all 86 records; never impute.

x-dataset.temporal_grain: Static source soil attribute lookup; no observation year assigned
x-dataset.spatial_grain: USDA SSURGO IA169 soil map unit (mukey), not individual polygon

provenance.transformation: Byte-for-byte copy of an existing validated CSV; no aggregation, imputation, conversion, or rounding.

requirements: Exact ordered source columns and declared CSV types.
Unique, non-null natural key within the declared spatial scope.
Finite numeric values, declared ranges, exact coverage and missing counts.
Source and output records identical, including order, precision and null markers.
Source/output/schema SHA-256 values and manifest metadata agree.
Dataset-specific calendar, denominator, quality and unit-consistency checks.

warnings: Root-zone AWS is NULL for all 86 map units and must never be imputed.
Texture, surface AWC, organic matter, drainage, and hydrologic group each have nine NULLs; slope has seven NULLs.
Map units are soil survey units, not farm/field ownership boundaries. No map-unit crop statistics or geometry is delivered.

x-csv.note: NULL and empty cells decode to JSON null only in nullable fields. Identifiers such as mukey stay strings. Units=null means not applicable or not separately verified.
